title: 進路セミナーⅡ
subtitle: Career Planning Seminar II
teachers:
WATANABE Nobuyuki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
The aims of this lecture are as follows:
1. To take a career view as a technician.
2. To set a goal for higher education or employment that suits you.
3. To be aware of your own ability and personality and set tasks based on them, and take your first step towards improving your problem-solving ability.
4. To accomplish the aims described above voluntarily and actively.
advice: This lecture introduces the activities needed at the beginning of a job search, self-analysis and industry research, and prepares students to look for a job at the end of the fiscal year.
requiredKnowledge: When looking for a job, your whole college life will be evaluated. Keep in mind that students should maintain a fulfilling life that includes not only lectures, but also extra-curricular activities.

activityGoals.body: Ability to think about the relationship between the career which you choose and your future life.
Ability to have a fufilling college life, which helps you choose a career.
Ability to set targets and goals for your own career, and to explain them logically for others to understand.
Ability to improve your knowledge and abilities that are necessary to acomplish your carrer goals.

achievementLevels.ideal:
1. Ability to draw clear conclusions based on sufficient examination of relationship between your life plan and career.
2. Ability to make a steady plan for thoughts and actions that are necessary to find your proper career, and act based on the plan.
3. Ability to explain your future plan to others, based on your abilities, preferences, occupational aptitude, knowledge of politics, and economics.
4. Ability to determine your current status and goals, make an action plan, and act based on it, based on knowledge, abilities, discipline, and qualities that are necessary to make a future plan.
achievementLevels.standard:
1. Ability to examine the relationship between your life plan and career, and draw conclusions.
2. Ability to gradually think and act towards finding the proper career.
3. Ability to discuss your future plan with others, after obtaining knowledge of your abilities, preferences, occupational aptitude, politics and economics.
4. Ability to determine the current status of the knowledge, abilities, discipline, and qualities that are necessary to make a future plan, and to try to make action plan and act based on it.
